title: Usuku Lomboniso Wokugqibela
intro: Libizelwe ukubonakalisa amandla amakhulu, iqela labadlali abanobuchule lazifumana lijongene nenyaniso engalindelekanga eyayiza kutshintsha ubomi balo ngonaphakade.
clues: Sasidume ngobuchule bethu, iingcali zokukhohlisa nokukhohlisa.
Sabizwa ngumlawuli ukuba siye kujongana nomchasi-mthetho owayephethe intonga elula.
Sathi sakubona inyaniso, sawa phantsi saqubuda, sivakalisa ukukholelwa kwethu eNkosini yehlabathi.
Lo mlawuli ungqongqo wasisongela ngesohlwayo esiqatha, kodwa asizange sigungqe.
Sasiphakathi kwabokuqala ukukholelwa kwisigidimi emva kokubona uphawu olucacileyo.
Sabulawa ngenxa yokholo lwethu, kodwa siya kuba ngabokuqala ukungena eParadesi kunye namalungisa.
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
